heroSummary: The 2026–27 BCPS school year begins Monday, August 31, 2026. If no emergency closure days are used, the scheduled last day for students is Monday, June 14, 2027. Thanksgiving break runs November 26–27, winter break runs December 24–January 3, and spring break runs March 22–29.

calendarNotes: The 2026–27 BCPS school year begins on August 31, 2026. Kindergarten transportation begins with the first full day of kindergarten on September 2. Schools are closed for Thanksgiving on November 26–27, following a three-hour early dismissal on November 25. Spring Break begins at the end of the school day on March 19; students do not attend March 22–29, and schools reopen March 30. BCPS lists 183 elementary student days and 184 middle and high school student days. June 15–17 are emergency closure makeup days if BCPS needs them.

whatsNew.title: What’s New for 2026–27
content: The first student day moves from August 25 in 2025–26 to August 31 in 2026–27.
The scheduled last day moves from June 11 to June 14, assuming no emergency makeup days are used.
Thanksgiving remains a two-day closure, running November 26–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for BCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Baltimore County Public Schools students is Monday, August 31, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is BCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break begins at the end of the school day on Friday, March 19, 2027. Students do not attend school March 22–29, and schools reopen Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the last day of school change?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. June 14, 2027 is the scheduled last day if no emergency closure days are used. June 15–17 are listed as emergency closure makeup days and may become attendance days if BCPS needs them.

calendarFaqs.q: Do BCPS conference days affect every grade?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Some conference days apply only to prekindergarten, kindergarten, or elementary students. Check the date label and your school’s messages before arranging child care.
